audience.text: Go developers building applications that need to generate, read, or modify Excel spreadsheets without external native dependencies.

capabilities.text: Read and write cell values using A1-style references with Cells.Get and Cells.Set, supporting string, float64, int, and bool types.
capabilities.title: Cell data read/write

capabilities.text: Store formulas with Cell.SetFormula and evaluate them using the built-in CalculateFormula engine for SUM, AVERAGE, MAX, and MIN.
capabilities.title: Formula evaluation

capabilities.text: Apply visual formatting via Style objects that support font, fill, alignment, and border settings, with automatic style deduplication on save.
capabilities.title: Styling and formatting

capabilities.text: Restrict cell input with DataValidation rules for dropdown lists or numeric ranges, including custom error messages and styles.
capabilities.title: Data validation

capabilities.text: Create Excel tables with headers and auto-filters using Worksheet.AddTable and Table objects.
capabilities.title: Structured tables

capabilities.text: Import data from CSV files using Workbook.ImportFromCSV and export to CSV using Workbook.ExportToCSV with configurable delimiters.
capabilities.title: CSV import and export

capabilities.text: Protect workbooks with ECMA-376 Agile Encryption using Workbook.SetPassword and Workbook.VerifyPassword.
capabilities.title: Password-based encryption

capabilities.text: Process large Excel files with StreamingReader to handle row-by-row data without loading the entire workbook into memory.
capabilities.title: Streaming large files

limitations.text: Cell references are A1-style strings only; tuple/array indices are not supported.
CalculateFormula supports only SUM, AVERAGE, MAX, and MIN; other formulas return an error.
CSV import stores every field as a Go string and does not infer numeric or boolean types.
Round-trip fidelity depends on reusing original XML for unmodified content and regenerating only modified parts.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic Excel file creation and editing in Go using only the standard library, avoiding external system dependencies.
Supports low-memory processing of large Excel files via streaming row access, reducing peak memory usage.
Provides a built-in formula engine to evaluate common spreadsheet calculations like SUM and AVERAGE without external tools.
Allows secure handling of Excel files with password-based encryption using ECMA-376 Agile Encryption.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Cells FOSS for Go is a pure-Go library for creating, reading, and writing Excel workbooks (.xlsx) with no third-party dependencies.

workflows.name: Create and save a new workbook
workflows.text: Create a new workbook with NewWorkbook, write values to cells via Cells.Set, and save to disk with Workbook.Save.

workflows.name: Load, edit, and save an existing workbook
workflows.text: Load an existing workbook with LoadWorkbook, read or update cell values using Cells.Get and Cells.Set, then save the modified file.

workflows.name: Process large files with streaming
workflows.text: Use StreamingReader.ProcessRows to iterate over rows in a large file without loading the entire workbook into memory.

workflows.name: Apply styling to cells
workflows.text: Create a Style with font, fill, alignment, and border settings, then apply it to a cell using Cell.SetStyle.

workflows.name: Import data from CSV
workflows.text: Import a CSV file into a new workbook using Workbook.ImportFromCSV, specifying the delimiter.

workflows.name: Add data validation rules
workflows.text: Define a DataValidation with type, formula, and error settings, then attach it to a cell range using Worksheet.AddDataValidation.
